rules.when: The task is genuinely unresolved Playop architecture, design, migration, or investigation whose outcome can materially change the design, excluding an independent domain, security, final-diff, or coverage review.
rules.why: Use Claude Code with Fable at xhigh only for genuinely unresolved Playop architecture.

rules.when: The task is an independent Playop domain, security, final-diff, or coverage review.
rules.why: Keep every required independent Playop review on Claude Code with Fable at medium effort.

rules.when: The Playop task is battle resolution or implementation, architecture, investigation, remediation, or validation whose accepted scope involves source-side privacy, persistence, authorization, replay, or authoritative undo.
rules.why: Use Claude Code with Fable at high effort for foundational Playop authority and state contracts.

rules.when: The task is any other Playop implementation, architecture, investigation, remediation, validation, bounded contract, protocol, UI, fixture, documentation, or test work.
rules.why: Use Claude Code with Fable at medium effort for bounded Playop work.
